Included is a vivid blue piece likely to be lapis lazuli, known for its deep ultramarine color and speckled texture. Also present is a white matrix rock embedded with brilliant blue minerals, offering an eye-catching contrast and crystalline sparkle. Completing the set is a quartz-like stone hosting embedded black crystals, possibly black tourmaline, with defined geometric structure and a dramatic natural look. Each mineral specimen has distinctive features, making this lot a great choice for collectors, educational displays, or enthusiasts of natural earth treasures. These unpolished pieces highlight raw geological beauty, suitable for display in any setting. All items are presented in good condition, with naturally occurring textures and occasional minor marks due to their unrefined state. Add these unique and visually striking minerals to your collection for a touch of natural history

The assortment will enhance any decor, spark curiosity in geology, or serve as a tactile teaching aid.
